image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured surface of green moss and grey rock. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and patches. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is visible with small dark eyes, and the limbs are splayed out against the substrate. The tail extends towards the bottom right, tapering to a rounded tip.
